sections.title: What MAUDE structurally is
sections.blurb: Properties of the dataset, not of any method applied to it. Held by fda-facts.

answers.question: what is one-event-several-reporters
answers.rendered: A single real-world event can produce a manufacturer report, a user facility report and a voluntary report, filed separately by three parties who never spoke to each other. Each arrives as its own record, so the report count exceeds the event count before any error is made. [evt_01M2HWP4QY4KP7GPGEYNS05K3F]

answers.question: what is follow-ups-are-separate-records
answers.rendered: A follow-up submission to an earlier report is stored as its own record rather than as a revision of the original, so a single well-documented event accumulates records over time without anything new having happened. [evt_01M2HWP4QY4KP7GPGEYNS05K3G]

answers.question: what is identifiers-are-dirty
answers.rendered: Brand names, model numbers and manufacturer names arrive as free text with no enforced vocabulary, so one device appears under several spellings. Grouping on any of those fields naively will not collapse the records that belong together. [evt_01M2HWP4QY4KP7GPGEYNS05K3H]

sections.title: What the data cannot say
sections.blurb: Three limits fixed by the dataset itself. No method reaches past them.

answers.question: what is no-denominator
answers.rendered: MAUDE contains counts, not rates. Nothing about how many devices are in use appears anywhere in the file, so no count drawn from it can be converted into a rate, and differences between product codes reflect market size, reporting practices and reporting requirements as much as anything about a device. [evt_01M2HWP4QY4KP7GPGEYNS05K3C]

answers.question: what is a-report-is-not-a-finding
answers.rendered: An MDR is a report rather than a finding. The FDA does not verify the reports it receives, and the existence of a report does not establish that a device caused the event described in it. [evt_01M2HWP4QY4KP7GPGEYNS05K3D]

answers.question: what is the-summary-reporting-boundary
answers.rendered: The FDA has run summary reporting programmes under which certain events were reported in aggregate rather than as individual public MDRs. Where a product code is affected, counts on either side of that boundary are not comparable, and a series that joins them without saying so is wrong in a way no method can correct. [evt_01M2HWP4QY4KP7GPGEYNS05K3E]

sections.title: The method
sections.blurb: Two deterministic passes, versioned. Held by maude-method, which holds no results.

answers.question: what is the-goal-of-the-method
answers.rendered: The method estimates the number of distinct real-world events behind a set of reports. It does not attempt perfect record linkage, and it says so rather than leaving a reader to infer the limit from a number that looks exact. [evt_01M2HWP4VFMYZ61KWD0C6EQSME]

answers.question: what is exact-linkage
answers.rendered: Pass one groups records that share an event key where one is present, and groups follow-up submissions to their initial submission through the shared report number root. [evt_01M2HWP4VFMYZ61KWD0C6EQSMF]

answers.question: what is fuzzy-linkage
answers.rendered: Pass two works within a single product code. Two records are a candidate pair when the normalised manufacturer name matches, and the date of event falls within plus or minus 3 days, and the event type matches, and at least one of the normalised brand name, lot number or model number matches. [evt_01M2HWP4VFMYZ61KWD0C6EQSMG]

answers.question: what is confirming-a-candidate-pair
answers.rendered: A candidate pair is confirmed when the two records share an identical product problems set, or when their event descriptions reach a MinHash Jaccard similarity of 0.6 or above. [evt_01M2HWP4VFMYZ61KWD0C6EQSMH]

answers.question: what is clustering
answers.rendered: Confirmed pairs are resolved into clusters by union-find, and one cluster counts as one estimated event. [evt_01M2HWP4VFMYZ61KWD0C6EQSMJ]

answers.question: what is duplicate-rate
answers.rendered: Raw reports is the count of records carrying the product code, dedup events is the count of clusters remaining after both passes, and duplicate rate is one minus dedup events divided by raw reports. [evt_01M2HWP4VFMYZ61KWD0C6EQSMK]

answers.question: what is versioning-the-method
answers.rendered: Every figure published from this method carries its method version. The method is never changed quietly: a change bumps the version, the outputs of the prior version are kept, and the change is written into the amendments log. [evt_01M2HWP4VFMYZ61KWD0C6EQSMM]

answers.question: what is why-the-corrected-number-is-not-already-published
answers.rendered: Correcting a report count into an event count requires a method, a method requires a validation set, and a validation set requires somebody to hand-label pairs as the same event or not. That work is unglamorous, it has to be redone whenever the method changes, and there is no published place to put the result, so the raw number stays in circulation. [evt_01M2HWP4VFMYZ61KWD0C6EQSMN]

sections.title: Whether it works
sections.blurb: The only cell allowed to answer this is eval-gates, and its answer is mostly no.

answers.question: what is the-validation-set
answers.rendered: A sample of candidate pairs per product code is labelled by hand as duplicate, not duplicate, or unsure. Where more than one person labels, inter-annotator agreement is measured and published alongside the result. [evt_01M2HWP4YQDZ14G0ZW3NTNX0K2]

answers.question: what is holding-the-gold-out
answers.rendered: The labelled set is held out. The clustering code never reads it, and the build fails if it does. [evt_01M2HWP4YQDZ14G0ZW3NTNX0K3]

answers.question: what is the-precision-target
answers.rendered: Precision against the labelled set targets 0.85 or above. This is a design target, not a measured result, because no labelled set exists yet. [evt_01M2HWP4YQDZ14G0ZW3NTNX0K4]

answers.question: what is the-recall-target
answers.rendered: Recall against the labelled set targets 0.70 or above. This is a design target, not a measured result, because no labelled set exists yet. [evt_01M2HWP4YQDZ14G0ZW3NTNX0K5]

answers.question: what is what-has-been-measured-so-far
answers.rendered: Nothing. No precision figure, no recall figure, and no duplicate rate for any product code has been produced from real data by this method. Every number this cell holds is a target awaiting a validation set. [evt_01M2HWP4YQDZ14G0ZW3NTNX0K6]

answers.question: what is enforcing-the-floor
answers.rendered: The publishing pipeline refuses to deploy a scorecard whose precision sits below the published floor. That is a build step rather than a promise, and it fails closed. [evt_01M2HWP4YQDZ14G0ZW3NTNX0K7]

answers.question: what is the-fixture-rule
answers.rendered: Until a real labelled set exists the pipeline runs against a fixture set marked synthetic in its own header, and the scorecard generator refuses to publish a card built from it, writing the card to a fixtures directory instead. The pipeline can be exercised end to end without one unvalidated number reaching a published page. [evt_01M2HWP4YQDZ14G0ZW3NTNX0K8]

answers.question: what is the-expansion-gate
answers.rendered: Coverage stays on a small allowlist of product codes until precision against a real labelled set reaches the floor. Expanding before then would multiply an unmeasured error across the database. [evt_01M2HWP4YQDZ14G0ZW3NTNX0K9]

sections.title: What the output may not say
sections.blurb: The cell whose job is to say no. Held by claims-policy.

answers.question: what is no-rate
answers.rendered: No output may express a count from MAUDE as a rate. The dataset carries no denominator, so a rate computed from it would be a ratio to a number nobody has. [evt_01M2HWP5213ECZRKY41RP02BCC]

answers.question: what is no-causation
answers.rendered: No output may state or imply that a device caused an event. A report is not a finding, and the regulator that collects the reports does not verify them. [evt_01M2HWP5213ECZRKY41RP02BCD]

answers.question: what is no-ranking
answers.rendered: No output may rank devices or manufacturers against one another, and no comparison surface may use the words better or worse. Differences in counts track reporting behaviour at least as much as anything else. [evt_01M2HWP5213ECZRKY41RP02BCE]

answers.question: what is always-estimated
answers.rendered: Every distinct-event count and every duplicate rate is described as an estimate produced by a published method, and appears with its method version attached. [evt_01M2HWP5213ECZRKY41RP02BCF]

answers.question: what is the-banned-vocabulary
answers.rendered: The words safe, unsafe, dangerous and problem device never appear in any output, in any context, including where a source document uses them. An output that needs one of those words is an output that has left the evidence behind. [evt_01M2HWP5213ECZRKY41RP02BCG]

answers.question: what is product-code-level-only
answers.rendered: Output stays at product code level until the nominative use question is settled. No manufacturer or brand breakdown is published before then, and the output format is shaped so that adding one later does not break the schema. [evt_01M2HWP5213ECZRKY41RP02BCH]

answers.question: what is the-honest-gap
answers.rendered: Any surface carrying these numbers also carries what has not been built yet. Removing that section to make a page read better is not permitted, because it is the cheapest credibility available and it costs nothing. [evt_01M2HWP5213ECZRKY41RP02BCJ]
